purposeStatement: Horizontal group of 2-4 equal-width segments for switching between mutually-exclusive views/options in one context; NOT for triggering actions (Button), binary on/off (Switch), or page navigation (Link).

antiPatterns.pattern: A row of Buttons toggled by tracking which one is 'active' in local state
antiPatterns.reason: Buttons trigger actions and have no single-select semantics or equal-width segment styling, so each build re-invents the selected/muted treatment differently.

antiPatterns.pattern: Multiple Switch components to pick one of several options
antiPatterns.reason: Switch is binary on/off; using several for one-of-N is ambiguous and lets multiple be on at once.

antiPatterns.pattern: A raw <div> of <span>s styled inline with token literals for the selected pill
antiPatterns.reason: An inline one-off bypasses the registered component, so radius/fill/text treatment drifts between screens.
